# Thermo Direct

> > NATE-certified HVAC, plumbing, and electrical contractor serving Raleigh, Cary, Chapel Hill, and Durham, NC since 2000.

Thermo Direct, Inc. is a full-service home services company providing heating and cooling installation and repair, plumbing services including leak detection and drain cleaning, and electrical work including lighting, generators, and surge protection. The company holds BBB accreditation, Angi Super Service awards, and NATE/NCI certifications.

## Key Topics

- HVAC maintenance and repair
- Furnace repair and heating systems
- Energy efficiency and tune-ups
- Plumbing services (leak detection, drain cleaning)
- Electrical installation (lighting, generators, circuit breakers)
- Water damage prevention (sump pumps, leak detection)
- Service areas: Raleigh, Cary, Chapel Hill, Durham NC
- NATE and NCI certified technicians
- LED lighting installation
- Generator installation and backup power
- Water softener systems
- Home safety and electrical inspections
- Eco-friendly plumbing solutions
- Air duct cleaning and indoor air quality
